scope: Synthetic browser acceptance of actual React components and CSS. Not live provider consent, physical-device, native-app, assistive-technology, production, or release acceptance.

environment.browser: Cloud Chrome via supported CUA API
environment.phoneViewport: same-origin iframe with explicit width controls
environment.largeText: document root font-size 200% (32 CSS px), not native browser zoom or physical Dynamic Type
environment.network: fixture transport only, external requests blocked; no online mutations observed

limitations: Not an exhaustive WCAG audit; no physical iPhone/Android or assistive-technology run in this segment.
The fixture uses synthetic account responses. Real consent/callback/provider activation is not tested.

Synthetic PDF presence survived locale changes in the rendered form. File bytes/hash/scope were not independently recovered from browser export: iframe download event timed out and reset REPL. Existing dedicated PDF/export tests are separate evidence.
Final desktop RTL, exhaustive all-screen/theme combinations, and a complete rendered post-fix Follow-ups revisit were not completed.

Browser URL policy rejected iframe waitFor after a reload with an unsupported-protocol/authority-to-observe message. No workaround, alternate browser surface, or further content inspection was attempted. Tab79 retained for review and CUA completion summary sent.

Static daemon files and source were restored to the rendered CSS89d8 candidate. The already reloaded live tab may retain the subsequently reverted optional CSS basis until a legitimate reload; its current pixels were not inspected after the policy rejection.

Fixture initial-failure error sentence is intentionally synthetic English text; production app-owned fallback labels translated. Brand names, URLs, user/employer text and browser-native date-picker labels remain original.
